name: Partial Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width.
Pull yourself up about halfway, until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Lower under control to a hang.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A partial-range chin-up that builds strength in the strongest portion of the movement toward full chin-ups.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Build to full range over time; stop with elbow or shoulder pain.
